title: Las Vegas Grand Prix

overview.about: The Las Vegas Grand Prix is Formula 1's boldest modern spectacle - a Saturday-night race down the Las Vegas Strip past the casinos and neon, revived in 2023 (the city also hosted races at Caesars Palace in 1981-82). Its long straights and cold desert night make it one of the fastest, most unusual events on the calendar, run late at night to suit global television. The 2026 race is on 19-21 November.
overview.nextEvent: The 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix runs 19-21 November, racing down the Strip after dark. The low night-time temperatures make tyre warm-up a major challenge, and the street layout's long straights produce very high top speeds.

@graph.description: The Las Vegas Grand Prix returned to the Formula 1 World Championship in 2023 on the Las Vegas Strip Circuit, a street layout that runs through the city’s resort corridor. It is a night race, which makes the local timetable and track-access arrangements integral to the event rather than incidental travel details. The existing OneSliders page records the current calendar dates in Event JSON-LD, and this data file carries those source dates without adding an assumed schedule. As with every Formula 1 round, the core sporting programme consists of practice, qualifying and the Grand Prix. Official event channels are the authority for the final daily timetable, ticket terms and circuit-entry information.
